The '''Tree of Death''' was a sacred [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] located in the Upper [[Flamewood]], in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It was located just west of the [[Holy Path of Mir]].
